messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed a weird case where promo/contract credits didn't apply to last month's Dedicated invoice for customer ACME-EU. Billing export shows zero promo credits used even though the contract credit pool exists. Looping infra + billing to investigate.

omar: Can you paste the invoice id and customer ledger id? Are these credits region-scoped or global on the contract? :eyes:

maya: Invoice: INV-2026-01-ACME-3421, ledger_customer_id: cust_acme_eu_42. From the billing export (csv) the allocation row is empty for `promo_credit_id`. snippet:
```
invoice_id,customer_id,amount_usd,promo_credit_id,region
INV-2026-01-ACME-3421,cust_acme_eu_42,14235.00,,eu-west-1
```
I double-checked contract: contract shows contract_credit_pool `ACME-COMMIT-2025` with remaining balance and expiry 2026-06-30.

jin: Quick thought — Dedicated commit was reserved in eu-central but we sometimes route overflow/spot to us-west for burst. If credit application logic matches invoice region to credit pool region strictly, a global pool might be getting skipped.
Can you run this query to see allocation mappings?
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, region, credit_pool_id, applied_amount 
FROM billing.allocations 
WHERE invoice_id = 'INV-2026-01-ACME-3421';
```

billing-bot: automated-check: promo_credit_id=PC-ACME-2025-01 (status: active), expiry=2026-06-30, credit_pool_scope=GLOBAL, last_sync=2026-01-02T03:12:08Z. No automatic expiry recorded for this invoice period.

alex: If the pool is truly GLOBAL but invoice rows show region=eu-west-1, there might be a mapping bug where `region` != `pool.region` causes skip. We should also check the routing policy used for the requests billed on that invoice (were tokens served from us-west?).
I can patch a one-off reapply script to retro-assign the credit to this invoice if finance approves. Example command (dry-run):
```bash
python ops/reapply_credits.py --invoice INV-2026-01-ACME-3421 --credit-pool ACME-COMMIT-2025 --dry-run
```

sara: Thanks for the detail. Finance perspective: we can do a retro apply journal entry but need: 1) confirmation that contract terms allow cross-region application, 2) signed CS approval for the credit use, and 3) a short note for auditors explaining why credit wasn't auto-applied. If infra confirms bug, we prefer retro-apply + fix for future invoices.

jin: Agree. I suspect a join in the billing job uses `invoice.region = pool.region` instead of allowing global pools. I'll open an infra bug and a fix PR today. Quick mitigation: we can re-run the allocator for that invoice window to re-evaluate eligible pools.

maya: I'll get CS to sign off and attach the contract clause. CS owner @lena will confirm. Also filing a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-1234 — assigning to infra + billing.

omar: Once CS and contract are in place, finance will approve the retro journal. Please drop the reapply dry-run output here so we can verify amounts. If any partial credits already consumed, we'll need precise breakdown.

maya: Roger. Running dry-run now and will paste results in thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
